title: SPLIT draws its graphic half at full width, not shrunk into a corner
goal:
Krish, 3 Nov 2026: "The graphics in your previous car are honestly fucking embarrassing." FormatMaster scales the whole SPLIT stage by FWP_STAGE_SCALE (0.76) with a top-centre origin, so every card on a split beat is drawn at three quarters of its size in a box beside the mark tile. His reference (instagram_DeZuQ7-lATg) draws product cards at 89% of the width with 60 px margins on our canvas.

1. Remove the stage scale from SPLIT in FormatMaster: the graphic half is the canvas above FWP_SPLIT_SEAM_Y at full width. Keep FWP_STAGE_SCALE exported for the frozen mocks only, and name it so (FWP_MOCK_STAGE_SCALE) with a comment that real beats never use it.
2. A SPLIT object with no `place` gets a default box: left 60, top 300, width 960, height FWP_SPLIT_SEAM_Y - 360.
3. Update scripts/velib/qc.py's _split_geometry reader to the new name, so QC reads the same number.

Tests: a SPLIT beat's wrapper has no scale transform; an unplaced object's box is 60,300,960,(seam-360); `place` still works; the mocks still pass with the renamed constant.
contract: Device rules: apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md. One clock (useCurrentFrame only in apps/renderer/src/engine/clock.ts). Pure functions of props, no Math.random, no wall clock. Colour roles from tokens, never raw hex. The standard is docs/ve/MOTION_STANDARD.md; every number below is measured there from Krish's inspiration-board reels.
